comments.body:
Reviewed `215e79a`: no actionable findings in the current diff.

The three models' pinned metadata, effort levels, and sampling settings match the official documentation. The Sonnet 5.5 `between_tools` mapping is consistent with the documented lowest thinking setting, and the default fallback preserves the existing `disabled` behavior for other adaptive models. The added request-body tests cover the relevant off-mode differences.

Validation on this commit passed:
- `go test ./internal/models/...`
- `python3 scripts/model-catalog/generate.py --check` (29 providers, 353 catalog rules)
- `git diff --check` against the merge base

No live model API calls were made.

#4155 has now been merged, so this PR currently conflicts with main in `internal/models/providers/providers_test.go` and `internal/models/parity/testdata/catalog-baseline.json`. Please update the branch and resolve those conflicts, preserving #4155's six-model sampling fixes and regression tests alongside these three new entries and tests. Regenerate/verify the catalog and parity baseline against the combined changes, then rerun the tests and CI before merging.

Rebased onto main (897c59a), resolving the conflicts with #4155:

- `providers_test.go`: kept both `TestClaudeNoSamplingRequestBody` (#4155) and `TestClaude55Models`.
- `catalog-baseline.json`: regenerated with `WEKNORA_UPDATE_MODEL_BASELINE=1` on the combined tree. Against main it only adds the three 5.5 entries; the hashes from #4155 are unchanged.

Validation on 897c59a: `python3 scripts/model-catalog/generate.py --check` (29 providers, 353 catalog rules), `go vet ./internal/models/...` and `go test ./internal/models/...` (Go 1.26), `gofmt -l` clean, `git diff --check` against main clean.
